newsitem.title: USA: AIG Q2 domestic net premiums written up.
newsitem.headline: AIG Q2 domestic net premiums written up.

text.p: American International Group Inc said net premiums written in its domestic brokerage group rose 10.4 percent, exclusive of risk management business, in a market that remains very competitive.

"Underwriting results were satisfactory, as we continued to focus on our core specialty products and remained disciplined in not seeking to build business in areas that fail to meet our underwriting standards," AIG chairman Maurice Greenberg said in a statement.
Workers' compensation rates, in particular, have continued to fall to unacceptable levels in a number of states, Greenberg said.
However, the direct auto business in the United States is showing strong growth and excellent results, he said.
